subsystems.name: Swerve
subsystems.summary: Four swerve modules, each with a Kraken X60 drive motor, a Kraken X60 steer motor and a WCP ThroughBore encoder (CANcoder inside), on can_s2 with the Pigeon 2 gyro.

facts.label: Motor pinions
facts.value: 10T steel spur gear (20 DP, WCP-1008) on all eight motors
facts.source: CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Drive supply current limit
facts.source: TunerConstants driveInitialConfigs, SupplyCurrentLimit 60 A (robot code main f1fdf68)

facts.label: Steer stator current limit
facts.source: TunerConstants steerInitialConfigs, StatorCurrentLimit 60 A (robot code main f1fdf68)

subsystems.name: Intake
subsystems.summary: A roller driven by one Kraken X60 (CAN 20) on a rack that two Kraken X44 motors extend, all on can_s4.

facts.label: Roller reduction
facts.source: 24T pulley on the motor (CAN 20) to a 36T pulley on a 60T belt; the rollers are linked 1:1 by 36T pulleys on 65T belts. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Rack drive reduction
facts.source: 10T spur gear on each Kraken X44 to a 28T spur gear, which drives the toothed rack plate. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Extension supply current limit (leader motor)
facts.uncertain: The code gives the follower rack motor no current limit config

subsystems.name: Shooter
subsystems.summary: Two Kraken X60 flywheels on a turret with a hood, fed by the vertical roller and the scotty (sushi) rollers, all on can_s3.

facts.label: Turret reduction
facts.source: 12T to 60T spur gears (5:1), 14T to 28T pulleys on a 45T belt (2:1), 14T driving gear to the 95T turret gear (6.79:1). The turret gears' tooth counts come from their diameters and centre distance (module 2.54); ShooterConstants.k_shooterGearReduction = 67.86 (robot code main f1fdf68) agrees. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Flywheel drive
facts.source: Printed motor pulley (G4012, 14T, counted on the robot 2026-10-08) to a 14T pulley on a 35T belt, then 40T to 22T spur gears. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Scotty (sushi) rollers drive
facts.source: 16T pulley on the motor to 16T pulleys on a 105T belt (1:1), then 26T to 30T spur gears. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Vertical roller drive
facts.source: 20T pulley on the motor to a 20T pulley on a 75T belt. CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)

facts.label: Hood drive
facts.source: Kraken X44 into a REV MAXPlanetary with one 5:1 slice; then WCP-2140 and two 9T helical gears (module 2.54). CAD part names and positions, Onshape Main Assembly microversion e5d5f77 (wiring/gear-trains.json)
facts.uncertain: The parts after the planetary have no tooth counts in their names

facts.label: Flywheel supply current limit (leader motor)
facts.uncertain: The code gives the follower flywheel motor no current limit config
